categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two segments: vision products and vision services. Vision products include rigid contact lenses such as orthokeratology lenses (corneal reshaping lenses), scleral lenses, and related care products, all classified as medical devices. Vision services encompass professional eye health services including vision correction, myopia control, vision function improvement, and dry eye and visual fatigue therapy, delivered mainly through community-based vision centers and clinics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in rigid contact lens materials, design, and manufacturing, including high and ultra-high oxygen permeability materials (e.g., OVCTEK 100 and OVCTEK 200). It employs personalized lens design and automated production systems for custom lenses. The company also develops related care products and safety monitoring devices, and has a comprehensive R&D system with clinical trials for new products such as multi-focal soft lenses, heated ultrasonic nebulizers, and ophthalmic drugs like low-concentration atropine eye drops.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include professional vision service institutions, hospitals, and end consumers primarily consisting of children and adolescents with myopia, as well as patients requiring vision correction. The company serves the medical device market for eye care and the broader vision health service market, with a focus on myopia control and vision correction products and services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with a strong presence in the East China region, which accounts for over 60% of revenue. Other growing regions include Northeast, North China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China. The company is expanding its service network and sales coverage across these regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. It develops, manufactures, and sells ophthalmic medical devices and vision care products, and provides professional vision services through its own and affiliated clinics and service centers. It also invests in upstream material production for lens manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing a full spectrum of vision products ('full vision products') and expanding vision services across all age groups. R&D focuses on advancing rigid lens materials, personalized lens design, new ophthalmic drugs, and vision health devices. The company emphasizes innovation in ultra-high oxygen permeability lenses, scleral lenses, and digital and automated fitting technologies, alongside expanding clinical trials and regulatory approvals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of customized rigid contact lenses, care products, and other vision-related products, as well as fees from professional vision health services. Sales channels include distribution, direct sales to medical institutions, and self-operated vision service terminals. The company also earns investment income and financial product returns.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player and pioneer in the rigid contact lens segment, especially orthokeratology lenses, with over 2 million cumulative users. It holds strong brand recognition with multiple proprietary brands. Despite increasing competition from new entrants and alternative myopia control products like defocus spectacles and soft lenses, the company maintains a leading market position through technological innovation and comprehensive service networks.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.81 billion, a 4.4% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 572 million, a 14.16% decrease. The company has total assets exceeding RMB 6 billion and net assets around RMB 4.7 billion, showing steady growth with some pressure on profitability due to market competition and increased expenses. The vision services segment now accounts for over half of total revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes personalized, high-quality rigid contact lenses with a wide correction range and superior oxygen permeability, enhancing safety and comfort. Its proprietary materials and automated design and production systems enable rapid, customized solutions. The company also offers comprehensive technical training and professional vision services, creating a strong brand and service ecosystem that differentiates it from competitors and supports sustained customer loyalty.
